## The Big Picture

- **Repository** - where the files live
- **Pages** - where the website is shown
- **Branch** - a separate version of the files to work on
- **Codespace** - where you work on the files, in the browser
- **Local Clone** - where you work on the files, on your own computer

## {background-image="images/github-repo.svg" background-size="contain" background-color="white"}

## Repository Review

- A project folder on GitHub that keeps the full history
- Every commit is saved with a message describing it
- Public repositories - anyone can see the files
- Private repositories - only you and your collaborators
- Invite collaborators under **Settings** > **Collaborators**
- Address: [https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks](https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks)

## {background-image="images/github-pages.svg" background-size="contain" background-color="white"}

## Pages Review

- GitHub Pages publishes a repository as a free website
- `index.html` is the home page of the website
- Turn it on under **Settings** > **Pages** > **Deploy from a branch**
- It rebuilds and publishes after each commit to `main`
- Watch the deployment in the **Actions** tab
- Address: [https://calvinw.github.io/BusMgmtBenchmarks/](https://calvinw.github.io/BusMgmtBenchmarks/)

## {background-image="images/github-branches.svg" background-size="contain" background-color="white"}

## Branch Review

- A branch is a separate version of the repository
- `main` is the official, working version
- Create a branch from the branch menu: type a name, then **Create branch**
- Commits on the branch do not change `main`
- Merge the branch into `main` with a **Pull Request**
- Delete the branch after it is merged - its commits stay in the history

## {background-image="images/github-codespaces.svg" background-size="contain" background-color="white"}

## Codespace Review

- A computer that GitHub runs for you, opened in a browser tab
- It runs Visual Studio Code - nothing to install
- Create it from one branch: **Code** > **Codespaces** > **Create codespace on** *branch*
- Make changes to the files in the editor
- Commit and push the changes back to the same branch

## {background-image="images/github-local-clone.svg" background-size="contain" background-color="white"}

## Local Clone Review

- A copy of the repository downloaded to your own computer
- `git clone https://github.com/calvinw/BusMgmtBenchmarks.git`
- The hidden `.git` folder holds the full history
- **Pull** gets new commits from GitHub
- **Push** sends your commits to GitHub

## Codespace or Local Clone?

|                     | Codespace                  | Local Clone              |
|---------------------|----------------------------|--------------------------|
| Runs on             | GitHub's computer          | Your own computer        |
| Install needed      | Nothing - just a browser   | Git and a code editor    |
| Get started         | Create codespace on branch | `git clone`              |
| Send changes back   | Commit and push            | Commit and push          |
